rule: serve the fine-tuned network only if it beats the frozen head on BOTH accuracy and macro-F1, measured on non-test data (head: grouped 5-fold CV on the fit split; fine-tuned: validation split). Test numbers are recorded, not used.
evidence: fine-tuned mobilenet_v3_large: validation accuracy 0.9182, macro-F1 0.8807; frozen head: grouped-CV accuracy 0.7742, macro-F1 0.7384
